payload.symptoms: conversion from clinically isolated syndrome to relapsing remitting multiple sclerosis
payload.supporting_quote: CIS-CIS patients showed significantly reduced CSF levels of YKL-40 and increased serum/CSF levels of HoxB3 compared with CIS-MS and RRMS patients.
It is upregulated in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, and traumatic brain injury.
Elevated CSF levels of chitinase-3-like protein 1 (YKL-40) were associated with disease progression in both AD and MS.
